text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a few friction points in the Batch > Vectors preview -> Export modal in the latest build. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/batch-export (screenshot)
jamie: quick summary I heard from usability: users aren't sure what "Export" actually produces. CSV vs JSON expectation mismatch.
maria: Right. Specifics:
- Primary button: currently "Export vectors" (ambiguous)
- Modal heading: "Export Vectors" but body says "selected queries"
- Table control: label "Compact density" is ambiguous for screen readers

sean: Proposals:
- Change primary CTA to "Download CSV" with a tiny dropdown for "JSON / Parquet".
- Modal heading -> "Export selected vectors". Body -> "Download selected vectors as CSV. Includes id, vector, and chosen metadata."
- Density control -> "Row density" with options Comfortable / Compact / Condensed.

lina: Accessibility notes:
- density control needs aria-label: "Row density, current: Compact" and update via aria-live polite on change.
- export progress should update an aria-live region: "Preparing CSV...", "Download ready".
- provide SR-only instructions in modal for choosing formats and keyboard access to the format menu.

aqil: Copy tweak: replace "selected queries" with "selected vectors" everywhere. I'll put together the cleaned copy.

jamie: tiny UX add — show a "View columns" link in the modal that expands a compact mapping: "id, embedding_vector, metadata.name". Keep collapsed by default.

sean: agree, but only show inline mapping when selection < 100 rows else link to modal to avoid clutter.
designbot: Note — if we change export format names, update telemetry key export_format. See https://redwood.infra/docs/telemetry/export-events

maria: Action items: Lina adds a11y notes + aria-live examples in Figma, Aqil posts copy PR, Jamie implements dropdown behavior and column mapping, Sean to add selection-size rule. Scheduling 15m sync tomorrow 11:00 to review. :thumbsup:
